summary: RELX PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing the Euro equivalent of its 2026 interim dividend of 20.9 pence per share. Shareholders in Euroclear Nederland receive €0.244 unless they elected sterling; CREST or register holders receive sterling unless they elected euro. The dividend is payable on 10 September 2026. This is a routine dividend currency announcement, not a special situation, so no deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are applicable. No acquisition, divestiture, or other corporate event is present; the filing merely states the currency conversion for an ordinary dividend payment.
